## Activity

During March 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 403 captures. Activity was delivered through the planned session schedule, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The recorded volume provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 403 captures, 21 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.2 per cent. The result should be considered alongside routine operational arrangements and used to support ongoing monitoring of capture quality. Images that cannot be graded do not provide a reliable basis for assessment and may require attention through local review of image acquisition and session processes.

## Grading

A total of 88 results were referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Overall, the activity record shows continued processing of captured images, with grading performance reported alongside the ungradable results to support service oversight. Further review of the ungradable cases may help identify opportunities to improve image quality while maintaining the planned operation of sessions.
